items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I was better than Dixon, that woman in Washington

ctx.x: Once you got back into music and were not praying as constantly as you had been, was there a change in anything?

Yes, there was a little change because you see, what I was trying to tell you, that ESP was in my music and the more music I played and the more jobs, it's not so much now, just a little. Maybe once or twice a year or three times a year. See, it's getting back into the music again, but it was on the outside. That's the reason why I told you that story so you'd know what had happened. See I had very good - I was better than Dixon, that woman in Washington, but I didn't know it; see, it was in my music.
